analysis.reasonEn: Despite two consecutive down days after the previous buy signal (RSI exiting oversold + extreme CCI rebound), the current price of $500.12 is nearly identical to the 20-day low of $500.03, approaching the support level at $500.10. The MACD histogram remains negative but continues to improve. RSI is hovering at 35.7 in oversold territory, seeking a rebound point. Volume is subdued at 0.60 of the 5-day average, indicating low conviction for further downside. Separate from the overall market downtrend, this ETF is entering a technically viable rebound zone.
